waivers.reason: GTK4 desktop application with no HTTP surface. Its actions are driven automatically over the session bus by `make e2e-gui`; page rendering is verified by screenshot, and WebKitWebDriver cannot drive this app in WebKitGTK 6.0.
No server API; the process is a local shell with an offline --smoke contract instead.

No route-based visual expectations for a desktop application. Diagram freshness and desktop-asset validation are covered by `make verify`, which adds diagrams-check and packaging on top of `make gate`.
